meta.title: 정보 추가 vs. 강조
meta.note: 교재 p.104~105와 정답·해설 p.76~77의 대표 Q01~Q04 원문·정답 논리를 직접 대조해 정보 추가와 강조 관계 중심의 source-aligned QA 세트로 정리함.

items.sentence: The list of ecological consequences of invasive species on their host environment is lengthy; they can cause local or global extinction of species as well as complete disruption of an ecosystem's structure and function.
items.prompt: as well as가 연결하는 두 결과를 차례로 선택하세요.
answers: local or global extinction of species
complete disruption of an ecosystem's structure and function
items.explanation: A as well as B는 B뿐 아니라 A도라는 추가 관계를 나타냅니다.

items.sentence: Identical twins who are separated at birth and raised apart in very different situations have been found to share personality traits. In addition, the twins held similar jobs, as they share job preferences.
items.prompt: In addition의 기능으로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
items.explanation: 성격적 특성 공유에 이어 비슷한 직업이라는 추가 정보를 제시합니다.

items.sentence: Many people today seek more and more privacy. Accidental contacts they do have, furthermore, seem more intrusive, not only because they are unsought but because they ultimately cannot be trusted by people.
items.prompt: Accidental contacts 뒤의 동사로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
items.explanation: 주어는 복수인 Accidental contacts이고 they do have는 이를 수식하는 관계사절이므로 복수동사 seem이 알맞습니다.

items.sentence: Many people today seek more and more privacy. Accidental contacts they do have, furthermore, seem more intrusive, not only because they are unsought but because they ultimately cannot be trusted by people.

items.sentence: The economy benefits from the presence of immigrants, because immigrants on average pay considerably more in taxes during their lives than they receive in government benefits, and as additional consumers, they increase demand for the products and services as well.
items.prompt: 경제가 이민자들의 존재로부터 이득을 얻는 원인으로 언급되지 않은 것을 고르세요.
choices: 이민자들은 대체로 더 많은 세금을 낸다.
items.explanation: 문장에서는 이민자들이 정부 보조금으로 받는 것보다 더 많은 세금을 낸다고 했지, 정부 보조금을 전혀 받지 않는다고 하지는 않았습니다.
